title: Please try my game and give me feedback. I'm trying to make a fun polished game in a genre I know is pretty saturated, but I really do enjoy roguelike games.
author: TheOriginalNobody1
selftext: So I've always enjoyed roguelikes and have been drawn to them from the original zelda to The Binding of Isaac. When I discovered how advanced claude has gotten through a family member I started playing around with it. At first it was just a fun proof of concept but then I just got sucked in and have been enjoying myself immensly. I've been dedicating all of my freetime (which isn't much being a dad and husband with a fulltime job) to just trying to improve it. I've been using Godot 4 for this project because it seems to be the simplest engine and is very convenient and easy to understand. Though I'm no expert I do know enough to at least get what claude explains to me and know enough to give it the correct prompt to tweak small things to polish how things work. Eventually I do want to release on steam. I think I have made a fun game but my sample size of people has been extremely small and need a lote more feedback. I do ultimately want to invest whatever I end up making (if I make anything) back into the game to make it better. I've already invested into some art assets because pixel art drawn by hand still looks better to me personally but Claude has definitely helped with this journey to bring my own game ideads to life. please correct me if this post needs editing.
